text: This candidate for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position received an overall fit score of 0.21. The strongest evidence for their application includes experience where they "Built REST APIs," along with listed experience in React and Git. Key gaps include missing must-have requirements such as nodejs, ruby, sql, docker, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as a total of 4.5 years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this application has been escalated for further review.
